image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing in dry, grassy terrain. The bird displays characteristic glossy black plumage with subtle iridescence, prominent red eyebrow combs (caruncles), and visible white undertail coverts. The legs appear feathered down to the feet, consistent with cold-climate adaptations.
